Subject: RE: Production alert — sudden p95 increase (model v9q)

Observations from initial triage (09:25 UTC):

- Canary and infra logs show an increased kernel selection penalty on sequence lengths >512 for v9q. That aligns with Helix’s traffic distribution (long-form claims).
- Diff between v9p (previous stable) and v9q shows: small change in fused-attention kernel and a new quantization tuning flag. I’ve attached the config diff (model-v9q-config-diff.txt).
- KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12% after the rollout (probable cache invalidation pattern).

Mitigation options (ranked):
1) Immediate tenant-scoped variant switch to v9p (fast, low-risk).
2) Traffic steering to dedicated Dedicated pool where v9q kernels behave better (requires capacity checks).
3) Roll forward with hotfix to quantization setting (longer validation).

I recommend option 1 for Helix to restore p95 under SLA while we investigate. Proposed rollback window: 09:45–11:45 UTC (2 hours) to observe behavior. I will prepare a quick canary for 5% of Helix traffic first, then move to 100% if stable.

Runbook: see rollback_runbook_link.txt (short checklist).

-Soojin
